name: Time-Feature Extraction
aliases: Time-Feature Extraction via Wavelet Singularity Detection
definition: An approach to extract and visualize time-features from time-resolved volume data by compressing each volume separately and analyzing the time evolution of spatially localized multiresolution information (Lipschitz exponents) to identify regions with strong temporal variation.
summary: Time-Feature Extraction identifies regions with strong temporal variation in volume data by measuring local Lipschitz regularity of wavelet coefficients, enabling adaptive compression that preserves high-variation features.
